ValidationRule.description: [IRM feedback row OppVR17] Requires PO Required? on moving into Negotiation and again into Booking Verification, for opportunities billing to the listed countries. Transition-based per IRM's stage-gate clarification.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( NOT($Permission.ECommerce_Deal_Bypass),
OR( RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Framework_Parent_Opportunity', RecordType.DeveloperName = 'Standard_Opportunity' ),
OR( ISPICKVAL(Type, 'New Deal'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Cross-Sell/Upsell'), ISPICKVAL(Type, 'Renewal') ),
OR( QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'United States', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Canada', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Ireland', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'France', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Belgium', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Netherlands', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Sweden', QTB_Billing_Country_Name__c = 'Denmark' ),
OR( AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Negotiation') ), AND( ISCHANGED(StageName), ISPICKVAL(StageName, 'Booking Verification') ) ),
ISPICKVAL(PO_Required__c, '') )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: PO Required? is required to advance to the next stage. Please select a value.
